retrieved_context: John Fogerty: John Cameron Fogerty (born May 28, 1945) is an American musician, singer, and songwriter.  He was the lead singer, lead guitarist and principal songwriter of the band Creedence Clearwater Revival.  The group had nine top-ten singles and eight gold albums between 1968 and 1972.  They were inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 1993.

John Lasseter: John Alan Lasseter (born January 12, 1957) is an American animator, film director, screenwriter, and film producer.  He currently is the chief creative officer of Pixar Animation Studios, Walt Disney Animation Studios, and DisneyToon Studios.  He is also the Principal Creative Advisor for Walt Disney Imagineering.
